messages.content: How many calories are in a tomato?

function.name: grocery_store_item_details
function.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific grocery item. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

item_name.description: The name of the grocery item.

store_location.description: The city or area where the grocery store is located.

details_level.description: Level of details required, 'simple' gives basic details, while 'detailed' provides comprehensive info about the item.

message.content:
A medium-sized fresh tomato (~123 g) contains roughly **22–25 calories**—about 23 on average.  
If you’re looking at canned tomatoes, sauces, or dried products, the calorie count will differ:

| Product type          | Calories per cup/serving |
|-----------------------|--------------------------|
| Fresh whole tomato   | ~23 cal                  |
| Tomato sauce (canned)| ~70‑80 cal               |
| Dried sun‑shined tomato flakes | ~120‑140 cal |

These values assume no added sugars or oils; if your recipe includes extra ingredients, add those calories accordingly.
message.reasoning:
The user asks how many calories are in a tomato. We can answer directly without calling the tool because it's general knowledge. Provide approximate value per typical serving (medium). Also mention variations.

We should not call the function unless they ask specifically for grocery store item details. So just respond with text.
